summary: Configured node1 to run inventory maintenance daily at 02:15 and append all output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Configuration and logging persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Normalized the malformed maintenance script and made it root-owned and executable.
Installed and enabled the daily cron schedule with stdout and stderr appended to the required log.
Verified successful output before and after reboot.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed a changed boot identity, recovered crond service, persistent schedule, and retained log data.

evidence.requirement: Run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retain its output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 02:15 cron entry, active/enabled crond, successful log append, correct file metadata, and post-restart persistence.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery for node1
evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID 31ef4c5a-d0ce-4247-87af-516d75324982, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 771d68f1-d6dd-4ffa-9718-1eaa042668de, and full service/configuration/log recovery.
